name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat|Unrack the bar and lower it to mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso|Press up until the arms are straight
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest|Flaring the elbows out to 90 degrees

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Sit on the bench with dumbbells on your thighs and lie back|Lower the weights to chest level with wrists stacked over elbows|Press up and bring the dumbbells together above the chest
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift too far apart|Arching the lower back off the bench

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Set the bench to 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells at shoulder height|Press up until the arms are straight|Lower slowly to the upper chest
mistakes: Setting the bench too steep so the shoulders take over|Using weight that shortens the range of motion

name: Push-Up
steps: Place hands slightly wider than the shoulders in a straight-line plank|Lower the chest to just above the floor|Push back up without letting the hips sag
mistakes: Sagging hips or a raised backside|Only moving through half the range

name: Cable Fly
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and step forward with a slight lean|With soft elbows bring the handles together in front of the chest|Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest
mistakes: Straightening and bending the elbows during the rep|Using momentum from the torso

name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above the chest and palms facing in|Open the arms in a wide arc with a slight elbow bend|Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together
mistakes: Going too heavy and turning it into a press|Lowering the arms far below shoulder level

name: Pull-Up
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than the shoulders|Pull the chest toward the bar by driving the elbows down|Lower under control to a full hang
mistakes: Kipping with the legs|Stopping short of a full hang

name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit with thighs secured under the pads and grip the bar wide|Pull the bar to the upper chest while keeping the torso tall|Return slowly until the arms are straight
mistakes: Leaning far back to swing the weight|Pulling the bar behind the neck

name: Barbell Row
steps: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and the bar below the knees|Pull the bar to the lower ribs|Lower the bar under control
mistakes: Rounding the lower back|Standing up with each rep to cheat the weight

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one knee and hand on a bench with the back flat|Pull the dumbbell toward the hip|Lower until the arm is fully stretched
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight|Pulling with the arm instead of the back

name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit tall with feet braced and knees slightly bent|Pull the handle to the stomach while squeezing the shoulder blades|Extend the arms slowly without rounding forward
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth|Shrugging the shoulders up

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip just outside the knees|Brace the core and push the floor away while keeping the bar close|Lock out the hips at the top then lower the bar along the legs
mistakes: Rounding the back at the start|Jerking the bar off the floor

name: Overhead Press
steps: Hold the bar at collarbone height with the elbows slightly forward|Squeeze the glutes and press the bar straight overhead|Lower back to the collarbone
mistakes: Leaning back excessively|Pressing the bar out in front instead of overhead

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with light dumbbells at your sides and a slight elbow bend|Raise the arms out to shoulder height|Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging the body|Lifting the hands above the elbows' line

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Sit with the back supported and dumbbells at shoulder height|Press the weights overhead until the arms are straight|Lower back to ear level
mistakes: Arching the lower back|Letting the elbows flare far behind the body

name: Face Pull
steps: Set a rope at face height and step back with arms extended|Pull the rope toward the face with the elbows high|Pause then return slowly
mistakes: Pulling with too much weight and leaning back|Dropping the elbows below the hands

name: Pike Push-Up
steps: Start in a downward-dog position with hips high|Bend the elbows to lower the head toward the floor|Press back up to the start
mistakes: Keeping the hips low like a regular push-up|Flaring the elbows wide

name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand holding the bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip|Curl the bar up while keeping the elbows by your sides|Lower slowly to full extension
mistakes: Swinging the torso|Letting the elbows drift forward

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other|Curl the weights up without rotating the wrists|Lower under control
mistakes: Using momentum from the hips|Shrugging the shoulders

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench and let the arms hang straight down|Curl both dumbbells up keeping the upper arms still|Lower to a full stretch
mistakes: Moving the elbows forward|Using weights that are too heavy to control

name: Cable Curl
steps: Face a low pulley and hold the bar with an underhand grip|Curl the bar toward the shoulders keeping the elbows pinned|Lower until the arms are straight
mistakes: Leaning back to lift the weight|Releasing tension at the bottom

name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Stand at a high pulley with the elbows tucked at your sides|Push the handle down until the arms are straight|Return until the forearms are just past parallel
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare out|Leaning over the weight

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands|Bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the head|Extend the arms back to the top
mistakes: Flaring the elbows wide|Arching the lower back

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on the bench with hands about shoulder-width apart|Lower the bar to the lower chest with the elbows close to the body|Press up to full extension
mistakes: Gripping too narrow and straining the wrists|Letting the elbows flare

name: Bench Dip
steps: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside the hips and legs extended|Slide off and lower the body by bending the elbows|Press back up to straight arms
mistakes: Dropping too deep and stressing the shoulders|Drifting far away from the bench

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Rest the bar on the upper back and set feet shoulder-width apart|Sit down and back until thighs are at least parallel|Drive through the whole foot to stand
mistakes: Knees caving inward|Rounding the lower back at the bottom

name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a kettlebell at the chest with the elbows pointing down|Squat down between the knees keeping the chest tall|Stand up by pushing through the floor
mistakes: Heels lifting off the floor|Leaning forward and dropping the weight

name: Walking Lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward into a long stride|Lower the back knee toward the floor|Push through the front foot into the next step
mistakes: Taking steps that are too short|Letting the front knee collapse inward

name: Leg Press
steps: Sit with the back flat and feet shoulder-width on the platform|Lower the platform until the knees reach about 90 degrees|Press away without locking the knees
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat|Locking the knees hard at the top

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at the hips with a soft knee bend|Push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs|Squeeze the glutes to stand tall
mistakes: Bending the knees too much so it becomes a squat|Rounding the back

name: Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down and set the pad above the heels|Curl the heels toward the glutes|Lower slowly to a full stretch
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad|Using momentum

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width and arms in front|Sit the hips back and down|Stand up by pressing through the heels and mid-foot
mistakes: Knees collapsing inward|Rising onto the toes

name: Hip Thrust
steps: Sit with the upper back against a bench and the bar over the hips|Drive the hips up until the body forms a straight line|Lower slowly and repeat
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top|Pushing through the toes instead of the heels

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat|Squeeze the glutes and lift the hips|Lower under control
mistakes: Pushing the lower back up instead of the hips|Letting the knees fall apart

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Place the rear foot on a bench and hold dumbbells at your sides|Lower until the front thigh is about parallel|Drive through the front heel to stand
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench|Leaning the knee past the toes with the heel lifting

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Hinge at the hips and hold the kettlebell with both hands|Snap the hips forward to swing the bell to chest height|Let it fall back and hinge again
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging|Lifting with the arms

name: Plank
steps: Rest on forearms and toes with elbows under the shoulders|Brace the abs and keep the body in one straight line|Hold for the planned time
mistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike|Holding the breath

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees|Extend the opposite arm and leg while pressing the lower back into the floor|Return and switch sides
mistakes: Letting the lower back arch|Moving too fast

name: Cable Crunch
steps: Kneel facing a high pulley holding the rope at the head|Curl the ribs toward the hips|Return slowly without sitting back
mistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs|Hinging from the hips

name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a bar with a firm grip|Raise the knees toward the chest by curling the pelvis|Lower slowly without swinging
mistakes: Swinging the legs for momentum|Only lifting with the hip flexors
